Verify an Overleaf Push

Source: R/rProject-verify.R
Verify.Rd

Checks a push from Overleaf to the private GitHub repository against the change-set log in .setup/logs.

Usage

Verify(
  path,
  private = file.path(path, ".verify"),
  log = NULL,
  record = FALSE,
  error = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

Character string. Project path.

private

Character string. Path to a clone of the private repository at the pushed commit. By default .verify in the project.

log

Character string. File name of the change-set log in .setup/logs. If NULL, the newest log with a pending push in .setup/logs/index.md, else the log named in the pushed commit message (Log: .setup/logs/<log>), as for a fix-up push.

record

Logical. If TRUE, write the commit and the result in the log's "Pushes" table and in .setup/logs/index.md, filling the pending row, or adding a row when there is none.

error

Logical. If TRUE, stop with an error when a check fails.

Value

Returns a data frame of checks with the columns check, status, and detail.

Details

The checks, and when each fails:

  • New commit: the commit is already recorded in index.md (.verify is stale, or there was no new push). Nothing is recorded.

  • Listed files: a file listed under "Files to update in Overleaf" is missing from or differs in the private repository.

  • Deletions: a file listed under "Delete in Overleaf" is still in the private repository.

  • Unlisted changes: (warning only) other files differ between the project and the private repository.

  • Commit message: (warning only) the last commit message does not end with Log: .setup/logs/<log>.

  • Secrets: SecretScan() finds a token in the private repository.

  • Public export: a file that make auto would publish is private (e.g., .setup/ai/, .setup/logs/, .setup/repo/, AGENTS.md) or larger than 50 MB.

  • Repo info: .setup/repo/private-overleaf.md is not an Overleaf project URL (for example, a share link, which grants access). Warning only: a file in .setup/repo/ is missing, private-github.md differs from the .verify remote, or public-github.md differs from the repository in clone.sh.

Generated files (e.g., NAMESPACE, man/), local folders (e.g., .library), and secret files are never compared.

The private repository must be cloned on the host, because SSH keys are not available in the container. .setup/scripts/verify.sh clones or pulls it into .verify (local only; never uploaded) and then calls Verify().
